outcome: Necrotizing enterocolitis stage 2 or above or death
Severe retinopathy of prematurity or death
cohort: 117,941 infants 23 0/7 to 34 6/7 weeks' gestational age born between January 1, 2009, and December 31, 2013
finding: Among infants born from 23 to 34 weeks' gestation, antenatal exposure to corticosteroids compared with no exposure was associated with lower mortality and morbidity at most gestations.
